summary: On this Linux/KVM host the containerized Android emulator (ghcr.io/vasic-digital/lava-android-emulator:api34-x86_64) starts but the Android guest never reaches sys.boot_completed=1 — the §6.Z device gate cannot produce evidence here, so the operator-requested 1.3.14-1080 distribute is BLOCKED (distributing without device evidence would be the §6.Z/1.2.19-1039 bluff).
trigger: Operator directive 2026-07-04: 'Once EVERYTHING is done, retested fully, validated and verified, rebuild everything and distribute fully fixed versions of both apps, both flavors dev and prod using Firebase distribution.'

attempts.boot_error: WaitForBoot timed out after 5m0s waiting for sys.boot_completed=1
WaitForBoot timed out after 12m0s waiting for sys.boot_completed=1

diagnosis: CONFIRMED: it is a boot HANG, not a slow-but-progressing boot — 12 minutes was insufficient exactly as 5 minutes was, and the guest never reaches sys.boot_completed. CONFIRMED: this is NOT the §6.AH KVM-absence class (KVM is present, accessible, and passed to the container via --device /dev/kvm per submodules/containers/pkg/emulator/containerized.go:102). This matches the prior sessions' 'QA device gate broken — keystones SKIP/FAIL on containerized emulator'. PENDING_FORENSICS: the exact boot-stall cause — candidate classes are (a) emulator GPU mode in the headless container (the emulator launch flags live in the image entrypoint, not containerized.go; a mode other than swiftshader_indirect/off can hang the guest at boot animation), (b) KVM acceleration not actually engaged INSIDE the rootless-podman container namespace despite --device /dev/kvm (falling back to TCG software emulation → a full boot can exceed even 12m), (c) an image/kernel-6.12 incompatibility. Distinguishing these requires a manual container boot with adb logcat + `getprop` + verifying qemu's accel inside the container — a focused Containers-submodule investigation.
anti_bluff_conclusion: The distribute is device-gate-BLOCKED and MUST NOT proceed on faked/absent device evidence (§6.Z clause 2 + 6, §6.AK, §6.L). The runner behaved correctly: it reported FAIL + RC=1 + 'MATRIX FAILED — tag.sh MUST refuse this commit' rather than emitting a green verdict. This is the anti-bluff gate working as designed.
bluff_classification: green-verdict-on-non-booting-emulator — the bluff this incident would represent IF the matrix runner had emitted a PASS/green verdict despite the Android guest never reaching sys.boot_completed (the exact class of the 2026-07-03 stale-verdict-PASS bluff that was already fixed in run-iteration/run-matrix).

falsifiability_rehearsal.claim_under_attestation: The §6.Z device gate FAILS-CLOSED on a non-booting emulator (does NOT emit a green verdict) — so a distribute cannot be authorized on absent device evidence.
falsifiability_rehearsal.mutation_that_would_expose_a_bluff: If run-matrix/run-iteration emitted verdict=PASS or all_passed=true on a WaitForBoot timeout (as the pre-2026-07-03 stale-verdict code did), that green-on-no-boot verdict would be the bluff.
falsifiability_rehearsal.observed_evidence_that_it_did_NOT_bluff: Both runs recorded all_passed=false + test_passed=false + boot_error='WaitForBoot timed out' + process RC=1 + stdout 'MATRIX FAILED — at least one AVD did not pass. tag.sh MUST refuse this commit.' The real-device-verification.json rows carry test_passed:false with the boot_error populated — no green verdict was produced. Evidence dirs: .lava-ci-evidence/2026-07-04T14-32-58Z-challenge-matrix + .lava-ci-evidence/2026-07-04T14-40-06Z-challenge-matrix.
falsifiability_rehearsal.reverted: n/a — no production mutation was applied; the rehearsal is the observed fail-closed behavior of the gate on a genuine boot hang. The runner's fail-closed path was itself hardened + Bluff-Audit-rehearsed on 2026-07-03 (see .lava-ci-evidence/sixth-law-incidents/2026-07-03-qa-harness-missing-apk-stale-verdict-pass-bluff.json).

remediation_options: Focused Containers-submodule fix: inspect the emulator image entrypoint GPU/accel flags; boot the container manually with adb logcat to find the stall stage; verify KVM is engaged inside the container namespace (qemu -accel kvm) vs falling back to TCG.
Run the §6.Z gate on a KNOWN-GOOD Linux/KVM gate host (prior cycles booted the emulator + passed C00 on 'thinker' and used 'nezha' — this host is a different machine exhibiting the boot hang).
Until either lands, 1.3.14-1080 stays undistributed — its user-facing fixes (search filter propagation; the credentials-decrypt FATAL fix) are committed + pushed + unit-verified but not device-gated.
